wordlists.lead: The search for forgotten documents, backups and service files on the client site runs in the “Full” profile (or “Custom” with the brute-force module) against scope targets. Here you set gentle default limits and wordlists.
wordlists.nf_rate_note: the client site should not notice the load
wordlists.nf_max_time_min_note: then brute force stops on its own
wordlists.nf_max_hosts_note: how many at once: Settings → Network
wordlists.show_paths_sub: “Path found on the site” findings (severity “Info”) are usually not needed
wordlists.exclude_empty: No excluded paths. Hosts and networks are excluded in the project scope.
wordlists.remote_hint: Downloaded from GitHub (SecLists, pinned version), not from the target site; size and checksum are verified.
wordlists.custom_hint: A text file with one word or path per line, up to 64 MB. Paths with “..”, parameters and addresses of other sites are dropped.
wordlists.title: Wordlists
sources.desc_startpage: Google results via Startpage: site:domain filetype:pdf… Opens in the built-in browser (hidden WebView), which passes the search engine check by itself
sources.desc_brave_web: Brave's independent index, no key: via the built-in browser
sources.desc_yahoo: Bing results via Yahoo: understands site:, filetype: and OR: via the built-in browser; from the EU it may ask for cookie consent (“Pass the check” button)
sources.desc_searx_pool: Pool of public SearXNG instances (searx.space: uptime ≥ 90 %); a rate-limited instance is skipped, no captchas
sources.desc_mojeek: Via the built-in browser when available; no guarantees: blocks data-center IPs
sources.desc_ddg: site:domain filetype:pdf…. No guarantees, captchas happen
sources.desc_wayback: Archived copies of documents (web.archive.org, the target is not touched)
sources.desc_cc: Web crawl indexes: the latest 3 or deeper, by years or all snapshots (below, “Search depth”)
sources.desc_arquivo: Portuguese web archive: search by file type
sources.desc_certspotter: CT logs, low limit without a key
sources.desc_hackertarget: Subdomains, ~50 requests a day without a key
sources.desc_shodanct: Subdomains from CT via Shodan data
sources.desc_otx_dns: Passive DNS; without a key often “limit”
sources.desc_subdomains: Only in “Standard” and “Full”: names from a wordlist and permutations of known ones. Via queries to the target's DNS; the wordlist is chosen in the launch wizard
sources.desc_urlscan: URLs from public scans (low limit without a key)
sources.desc_internetdb: Ports, software and CVEs by IP, passively
sources.desc_recon: Technologies with versions, analytics IDs, favicon hash, endpoints and secrets (masked) in the home page JS
sources.name_webaudit: Web audit: headers, CSP, source maps, API
sources.desc_webaudit: Security headers, domains from CSP, source maps and Swagger/OpenAPI; in passive mode only already received responses are parsed
sources.desc_wellknown: From the Wayback archive: hidden paths, sitemap URLs, security.txt contacts
sources.desc_buckets: Links to S3/GCS/Azure from pages and documents; listing only in “Full”
sources.desc_grepapp: Where the domain appears in public repositories; no guarantees: bot protection happens
sources.desc_ports: Only in “Full”: open TCP ports, banners and versions on live scope hosts (exclusions are not touched)
sources.desc_tls: Only in “Standard” and “Full”: certificates of open TLS ports on scope hosts (validity, chain, name); in “Full” also TLS 1.0/1.1, weak ciphers and STARTTLS
sources.desc_crawler: Only in “Standard” and “Full”: walks the pages of the target site
sources.desc_brave: Official Brave API with a key: one more dork engine. Needs a card; $5 monthly credit, about 1000 queries
sources.desc_searx: Your own SearXNG instance (address in “API keys”): asked before the public ones
sources.desc_shodan: Ports and banners from the Shodan database, without contacting the target
sources.access_web: No key · via the built-in browser
sources.access_opt: No key · higher limit with a key
sources.keyless_hint: Turns on by itself once the key is added in “API keys”
sources.lead: Source groups of the “Search” stage. A disabled source is never queried in any scan. Passive sources do not contact the target; the crawler, port scan, subdomain brute force and TLS inspector run only in “Standard” and “Full”.
sources.paid_summary: {n} paid service · optional|{n} paid services · optional
sources.hint: Groups instead of a long list: individual toggles are inside. Keys are needed only for paid services.
sources.title: Sources
toolbox.file_title: Check a file without a project
toolbox.file_hint: Metadata, forensics, personal data and secrets are checked locally on the device without saving to projects.
toolbox.mail_hint: Checks SPF, DMARC, DKIM, BIMI, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, CAA and DNSSEC via the configured DoH/proxy.
toolbox.host_hint: One request to the given host: TLS certificate, security headers, technology stack and favicon.
toolbox.sec_hibp: Check against the HIBP breach database (only a 5-character SHA-1 prefix leaves the device)
toolbox.sec_hint: By default the check is fully local: the value is not stored, logged or sent.
toolbox.log_empty_text: Network requests of the “Mail” and “Host” tools and the opt-in HIBP check appear here (passwords and tokens are masked).
toolbox.queue_hint: Runs the selected projects one after another without overlapping limits or locking up the device.
toolbox.active_b: The “Full” profile includes an active phase.
toolbox.active_text: Ports will be scanned, files on sites probed, DNS zone transfer (AXFR) and NSEC walking tried. Target owners will notice this.
toolbox.active_consent: I have the owners’ permission to actively test these targets
toolbox.menu_tools_sub: File, mail, host, password without a project
launch.err_email_domain: an e-mail is not a scan target. Enter the domain {domain}
launch.err_email: e-mail is not supported. Enter a domain, URL, IP or CIDR
launch.err_scheme: only http and https are supported
launch.err_asn: an ASN is not supported as a target. Enter a domain, IP or CIDR
launch.err_range_order: range end is before its start
launch.err_generic: enter a network target: domain, *.domain, URL, IP, CIDR or IP range
launch.prof_passive_d: Does not contact the target: search APIs, certificates, web archive, Shodan cache, SaaS and Microsoft 365 via DNS.
launch.prof_std_d: Passive + downloading public documents, DNS records, host liveness checks, subdomain brute force (top 1500) and TLS certificate checks.
launch.prof_full_d: Standard + active phase: search for forgotten documents, backups and service files on the site, zone transfer (AXFR) and NSEC walking, port scan of live hosts (top 100), TLS audit (outdated versions, STARTTLS), top-5000 brute force. CVEs passively from Shodan InternetDB.
launch.mod_search_d: Startpage and Brave via the built-in browser, no key; Brave API and SearXNG with a key
launch.mod_wayback_d: Old copies of pages and files
launch.mod_dns_d: Records and subdomains from the target's name servers
launch.mod_alive_d: TCP connect to 80/443 and common ports, no scanning
launch.mod_subdomains_d: Wordlist names and permutations of known ones. DNS queries to the target's name servers
launch.mod_tls_d: Handshake with open TLS ports of live scope hosts: validity, chain, name, CA
launch.mod_recon_d: Technologies, favicon, JS, robots/sitemap, cloud storage, grep.app. In “Passive” from the archived copy
launch.mod_infra_d: SaaS and Microsoft 365, mail policies, CDN, certificate history, host roles: without contacting the target
launch.mod_axfr_d: Attempt to fetch the whole zone from the target's NS
launch.mod_nsec_d: List of names of a signed zone from the target's NS. Like a zone transfer
launch.mod_ports_d: Open ports, banners and service versions on live scope hosts. Up to 20 hosts, exclusions are not touched
launch.mod_fuzz: Forgotten file search on the site
launch.mod_fuzz_d: Documents, backups, service files and listings on the client site. Gentle brute force with auto-stop
launch.fz_docs_d: Common folders and office file names, variants of known names (year, version)
launch.fz_backups_d: Backup copies of known files (.bak, ~, .old, .zip) and database dumps
launch.fz_dirlisting_d: Open “Index of /” pages and the documents in them
launch.fz_vhost_d: Client subdomains on the same address (scope only)
launch.fz_cms_d: Only when the CMS is detected from found addresses
launch.subhint_off: Brute force does not run; permutations of known names and PTR of scope addresses still work.
launch.subhint_1500: The 1500 most common names (SecLists), a few minutes.
launch.subhint_5000: 5000 names: wider coverage, slower and more visible to the target DNS servers.
launch.subhint_custom: Your own names: one per line or comma-separated.
launch.sub_d2: via queries to the target DNS. Its name servers see these queries. Scope domains only, no exclusions; “any name” (wildcard) answers are dropped.
launch.none_scan: The project scope has no targets. Add them on the “Scope” screen or enter them here. For this scan only, external sources only.
launch.none_new: No targets yet. Add a domain (example.com, *.example.com), URL (http/https), IP, CIDR or IP range.
launch.extra_post: for this scan only and external sources only. Requests to the target start once it is added to the scope.
launch.real_ip: Requests will go from your real IP
launch.doc_types_found: those found in the project are selected
launch.net_hint: All scan traffic goes through the proxy from settings. The same for the wizard and the scan.
launch.nf_threads_min: at least one thread is required
launch.nf_hosts_parallel_min: at least one host is needed
launch.net_shared: Threads, requests per second and hosts at once are shared with “Settings → Network”. The scan never exceeds the per-host request limit, even with many threads.
launch.fz_est_later: The request estimate appears after the project is created; total budget is up to {n} requests.
launch.fz_est: ≈ {n} request · ≈ {m} min at {rate} req/s|≈ {n} requests · ≈ {m} min at {rate} req/s
launch.fz_d: Looks for forgotten documents, backups, service files and open listings on the client site so the owner can remove them. Scope targets only, exclusions are not requested; if the site starts rate-limiting, brute force stops on its own.
launch.fz_rate_note: the site should not notice the load
launch.ports_d: Checks TCP ports of live scope hosts (up to {n} per scan), reads banners and service versions. Excluded hosts are not touched.
launch.ports_100: ~1 s per host. The most common services
launch.ports_1000: up to ~15 s per host. Wider coverage, more connections
launch.ports_custom: A custom port list is in “Settings → Network”.
launch.project_hint: The project is created when the scan starts or with the “Save” button.
launch.src_hint: No API keys needed. If you add them in “Settings → API keys”, paid sources connect by themselves.
launch.targets_ph: Domain (example.com, *.example.com), URL (http/https), IP or CIDR, one per line
launch.local_files_d: Documents from a USB drive or a folder are analyzed together with those found online.
launch.adv_sub: Exclusions, file types, depth, limits, network
launch.empty_text: Paste domains, URLs, IP addresses or CIDR networks.
launch.import_hint: Each line (or comma-separated value) becomes a target. Duplicates are merged, errors are shown separately.
launch.snack_t_skip: “{v}” will not be in this scan (still in the scope)
launch.clip_unreadable: Could not read the clipboard: paste the targets manually
launch.sub_empty: The custom brute-force wordlist is empty. Add names or choose another wordlist
launch.draft_saved: Draft saved: continue on the “Projects” screen
launch.excl_bad: An exclusion must be a host, network or URL
launch.excl_removed: Exclusion “{v}” removed: the address will be scanned
launch.leave_unsaved: not saved yet. The project has not been created.
launch.leave_keep_sub: You can continue on the “Projects” screen
launch.leave_drop_sub: Targets and wizard settings will be deleted
launch.started_resume: Scan resumed from where it stopped
launch.started_active: Scan with the active phase started
launch.hint_dup: This target is already in scope
launch.active_phase_v: “Full” profile: against all network scope targets except exclusions
launch.rules_sub: Ready-made sets and your own regular expressions for document text
launch.scope_no_targets: No targets: add a domain, *.domain, URL, IP or CIDR network.
launch.scope_empty_text: Add the project network targets: domains, *.domains, URLs, IPs or CIDR networks.
launch.tadd_title: Add a target to the scope
launch.tadd_ph: Domain, *.domain, URL, IP, CIDR or range
launch.xadd_hint: Exclusions override targets: the address is scanned neither by passive-active nor by active modules.
launch.basis_ph: Who authorized the engagement and when, a link to the letter
launch.basis_hint: If filled in, it goes into the report as the “Engagement basis” section.
launch.tmenu_d: A network scope target: “Passive” uses external sources only, “Standard” adds liveness and TLS checks, “Full” also AXFR, ports and the forgotten file search.
scan.reason_android_title: Android closed the app in the background
scan.reason_android_text: The system unloaded FOCA-rs from memory while the app was minimized. The scan runs through a persistent notification; to keep long scans from being interrupted, allow unrestricted background battery use.
scan.reason_thermal_text: Android reported severe heating and pause-on-overheat is enabled in power settings. The scan resumes on its own when the phone cools down; collected data is saved.
scan.reason_mobile_cap_text: Mobile data limit reached: {used} of {limit} MB this month. Resume on Wi-Fi or raise the limit
scan.reason_wifi_text: “Wi-Fi only” is enabled in settings and the phone switched to mobile data. The scan is paused to save mobile traffic; it resumes on Wi-Fi.
scan.reason_offline_text: The connection dropped. The scan is paused and resumes on its own when the network is back.
scan.reason_vpn_title: Tunnel dropped: the kill switch triggered
scan.reason_user_text: The scan was stopped manually. Everything collected is saved in the project. You can resume from the same point.
scan.reason_restart_title: The scan was interrupted by the system
scan.reason_restart_text: The app was unloaded or restarted during the scan. Everything found and downloaded so far is saved in the project. Resume from where it stopped.
scan.reason_budget_text: The standalone background scan hit the 8-minute WorkManager limit and saved a checkpoint. Tap “Resume from where it stopped” to finish the remaining stages.
scan.reason_wm_title: Stopped by the Android scheduler, you can resume
scan.reason_wm_text: The system stopped the WorkManager background task (network, battery or power-saving restrictions). Collected data is saved. You can resume from the checkpoint.
scan.reason_error_title: The scan stopped because of an error
scan.reason_error_text: A scan stage ended with an error. Everything collected so far is saved in the project. Resume from where it stopped.
scan.reason_battery_text: The battery dropped below the {n} % threshold from settings.
scan.reason_battery_pause: The scan is paused and resumes when the phone is put on charge.
scan.reason_battery_stop: The scan stopped so the phone does not run flat. Connect the charger and resume.
scan.ks_stopped: The kill switch stopped the scan
scan.ks_paused: The kill switch paused the scan
scan.reason_vpn_text: Tunnel {tunnel} stopped responding. {action} so that requests do not reach the target from your real IP. You can resume once the tunnel is back.
scan.reason_extract_text_file: The metadata extraction module crashed on file {name}. The rest of the data is saved.
scan.reason_extract_text: The metadata extraction module crashed. The rest of the data is saved.
scan.snack_auto_resume: The scan was interrupted by the system. Resuming from where it stopped
scan.ks_off: Off: if the tunnel drops, requests go from your real IP
scan.ks_on_pause: On: if the tunnel drops, the scan pauses
scan.ks_on_stop: On: if the tunnel drops, the scan stops
scan.fz_wait: Starts at the “Site search” stage: after “Network and DNS”
scan.fz_calib: Calibration: checking how the site answers non-existent addresses…
scan.fz_blocked: The site rate-limited requests. Brute force stopped, no retries
scan.fz_off: Only in the “Full” profile (or “Custom” with the module) after confirming authorization
scan.fz_stopping: Brute force is stopping. Results are kept, the scan continues
scan.ok_crawl_none: The site responded, no links to documents
scan.dork_blocked: The search engine showed a captcha or blocked requests
scan.wait_crawler: Visits the target site: after external sources
scan.wait_parallel: External sources are queried 4 at a time
scan.wait_network: Queried at the “Network and DNS” stage
scan.web_opening: The built-in browser is opening the search engine
scan.next_domain_sub: {what} for {domain}: will query for domain {i} of {n}
scan.verify_passed: Check passed: the source will be queried again in this scan
scan.verify_do: pass the check yourself (as in a browser), cookies are kept
scan.no_guarantee: works without guarantees, the scan continued
scan.ports_unreliable: The port scan is unreliable: the device network (VPN, AdGuard, proxy) accepts connections on any port. Turn off the local VPN or add FOCA-rs to its exclusions
scan.svc_limited: The service limited the request rate
scan.needs_webview: Needs the built-in browser (WebView). Works in the phone app
scan.headless_sub: Skipped in the standalone background scan (the built-in browser needs a window)
scan.skipped_user: Skipped at your request. The scan continued without it
scan.verify_phone_only: The check can only be passed in the phone app
scan.snack_requery: “{name}” will be queried again in this scan
scan.verify_saved: Check saved: the next scan will use it
scan.verify_need_d: Their dorks were handed to other search engines and are not lost. Pass the check once. Cookies are kept and dorks then run on their own.
scan.verify_all_aria: Pass the check in all search engines one by one
scan.verify_passed_n: Search engines after the check: {n}. Querying continues in this scan
scan.verify_passed_one: Check passed: the search engine will be queried again
scan.feed_none: No new findings yet. Already known ones do not enter the feed
scan.feed_later: New findings appear here after the “Analysis” stage
scan.oos_sub: Redirects, CNAMEs, networks and foreign domains
scan.oos_none: The scan has found nothing outside the scope yet
scan.other_pre: The scan is running in project
scan.other_post: Stages and findings are in that project.
scan.bg_note: In the background the scan keeps a persistent Android notification with “Pause” and “Stop” buttons.
scan.new_since_none: No new findings since the last scan
scan.idle_targets: Project targets: {list}{more}. Choose a profile and sources on the new scan screen.
scan.idle_no_targets: The project has no targets yet. Add them on the “Scope” screen or on the new scan screen.
scan.no_history: There have been no scans in this project yet.
scan.empty_text: Start the first scan. Stages, sources and findings will appear here in real time.
scan.err_title: Could not get the scan status
scan.err_text: The background service did not respond. The scan may still be running, try again.
scan.already_running: A scan is already running. Wait for it to finish or stop it
scan.snack_paused: Scan paused: downloads and requests are stopped
scan.still_offline: Still no network: the scan resumes on its own when it is back
scan.back_online: The network is back, the scan resumed
scan.ks_off_snack: The kill switch is off. Requests would go from your real IP. Turn it on in network settings
scan.stop_saved: Collected data is kept in the project
scan.stop_resume_later: You can resume later from where it stopped.
scan.stop_hint: If you just need a break, pausing is better.
scan.tunnel_dead: The tunnel is not responding, cannot resume
scan.demo_online_sub: The scan resumes on its own
scan.stop_reasons_demo: What the stop screen looks like
scan.last_ok: The last project scan finished normally, nothing to resume.
scan.no_scans_yet: There have been no scans in this project yet.
scan.last_ok_stop: The last project scan finished normally, nothing to stop.
scan.stopped_when: Stopped {date} · {dur} after start · at the “{stage}” stage, {p}%
scan.xiaomi_pin: On Xiaomi (HyperOS/MIUI) swiping the app away from Recents stops the scan. Turn on “Hide from Recents during scans” in Settings › Background execution, or lock the card: long-press it and tap the lock.
scan.demo_autostart: Demo: the MIUI/HyperOS autostart screen would open
scan.stub_autostart: Test stand: autostart opens only on the phone
scan.oos_none_text: The scan found no links, redirects, CNAMEs or networks outside the scope.
scan.oos_after_first: Candidates appear after the first scan.
scan.oos_lead: Found during the scan but outside the scope: redirects, CNAMEs, host addresses (one IP each, whole networks are not offered) and links to foreign domains. Active modules do not touch them until you add them to the scope.
scan.oos_next_scan: New ones appear during the next scan.
scan.oos_none_text2: The scan found no links, redirects or CNAMEs outside the scope.
scan.oos_shared_d: Sites of other owners may run on this IP. Only the address {host} is added, not the network.
scan.dns_slow: Slow DNS (VPN?): brute force will take ~{min} min
scan.ctl_pending: Not started yet: nothing to restart
scan.ctl_unsupported: This action is not available for this item
scan.ctl_paused: Paused, the rest of the scan goes on
scan.ctl_queued: The stage is over, queued; run “Re-run queued” after the scan
scan.followup_note: Queued restarts: {n}. Their stages were already over
scan.followup_stages: Only these stages will run: {list}. The rest will be skipped
scan.verify_next: Check passed: applies on the next scan or after restarting this source
scan.snack_verify_next: “{name}”: check passed. Applies on the next scan or after restarting this source
launch.bg_title: Keep the firmware from stopping the scan
launch.bg_lead: A scan can take a while. This firmware closes background apps. Check these two items before you start.
scan.sub_hint_add_domain: Add the domain as a target to enumerate subdomains
launch.none_fix: No valid targets yet: fix the lines with errors below.
launch.commit_empty: Enter a domain, URL, IP or CIDR, then tap “+”
scan.delete_running_text: The scan will be stopped and erased with everything it found so far: documents and their files, findings, hosts and the request log. This cannot be undone.
scan.delete_text: The scan will be erased with everything only it found: documents and their files, findings, hosts and the request log. This cannot be undone.
scan.delete_keeps: Anything other scans also found stays, with your notes and statuses.
scan.delete_hold: To delete, hold the Delete button for 1-2 seconds.
scan.verify_st_cancelled: “{name}”: check cancelled, the search engine stays blocked. You can pass it later
scan.verify_st_failed: “{name}”: the check page did not load. Check the connection or proxy and try again
scan.verify_st_not_solved: “{name}”: the check is not passed yet, the search engine still shows a captcha. Try again
toolbox.log_clear_text: Records: {n}. Only quick tool requests are deleted; projects and their request logs are not affected.
scan.dorks_next: They retry in the next scan.
scan.dorks_pending: {n} search postponed, will retry|{n} searches postponed, will retry|{n} searches postponed, will retry
scan.dorks_d: Every search engine showed a captcha. We never solve captchas: these queries retry slowly, one by one.
scan.dorks_scan: A short scan started: only search engines for the postponed queries
scan.dorks_busy: Another scan is running: retry after it
launch.cc_hint: A deep sweep runs in the background of the search stage and does not hold up other sources; unfinished snapshots continue in the next scan.
sources.dork_retry: Retry of searches postponed by captchas
sources.depth_hint: The Common Crawl index often answers with errors: requests go at most once every 3 seconds and failures are retried after a pause. A deep sweep runs in the background of the search stage without holding up other sources; results per domain are kept for a day and unfinished snapshots continue in the next scan. We never solve captchas: searches every engine answered with a captcha retry later, one by one.
scan.crawl_rate_slowed: slowed down: the site asks for fewer requests (429/503)
scan.crawl_resumed: continues the crawl of the previous scan
scan.crawl_rest: the rest ({n} pages) continues in the next scan
scan.crawl_no_render: JavaScript app pages without a browser: links from the HTML only
launch.crawler_hint: Standard and Full profiles: the site's pages, its sitemap and the files it links to. The Passive profile does not crawl the site.
launch.nf_crawl_pages_note: the rest continues in the next scan
launch.nf_crawl_min_note: then the crawl stops by itself
launch.crawl_storage: Files on external storage linked from the site
launch.crawl_storage_sub: Google Drive, Docs, OneDrive, Dropbox, SharePoint: only the files the site links to
launch.crawl_resume_sub: Start from the pages the previous scan did not reach
launch.linked_storage_rule: Only files linked from target pages
launch.linked_storage_on: Google Drive, Docs, OneDrive, Dropbox, SharePoint: only files that target pages link to are downloaded; nothing else on the storage is browsed. Such files in the project: {n}
launch.linked_storage_off: Turned off in Settings → Site crawl
launch.nf_crawl_depth_note: link hops from the home page
